title: Caller can't hear me on the desk phone
symptom: On desk phone calls she can hear the caller, but the caller cannot hear her
user_description: I can hear people fine when they call, but they keep saying hello, hello, as if I'm not there. It's embarrassing with suppliers!

options.why: The ringer is only the sound of incoming calls. It has nothing to do with what the caller hears.
Check the simple causes first. A handset is rarely broken.
The caller is not the problem: they cannot hear her at all.

options.text: Check whether the mute button's light is on, and check the coiled handset cord is clicked firmly into the handset and the phone, then make a test call
options.why: Mute stops the microphone, and a loose handset cord can cut the microphone too. A test call checks both directions.

hints: She can hear them, but they cannot hear her. Which part is not working?
Is there a light on any of the phone's buttons?
How is the handset connected to the phone?
real_world_tip: One-way audio on a desk phone is very often the mute button or a loose handset cord. Always finish with a test call so you hear it working both ways.
